note: Set A is better because it correctly binds dimensions to their specific details (e.g., identifying the 2" dimension with the PV Post base plate and the 1'-4 1/4" height with Detail A5), whereas Set B mislabels A1 (PV Post) dimensions as 'Crane Attachment'. Both sets contain significant redundancy (multiple claims for the same angle and pipe specs) and both incorrectly identify a Plate (PL 3"x3/8"x1'-6") as an 'angle' in at least one claim, though Set B also includes a correct 'Plate' claim for that item. Set A's superior context binding outweighs the redundancy and single entity error.
